posts.texto: A major milestone for Strata! Now there is only one way for Local AI.. go even faster☄️
Strataの進化が止まらない。ついにNVIDIA/AMD向けのプロンプト処理を独自GPUカーネルに移行し、llama.cppへの依存をさらに削減。
GPU 2枚でローカルLLMを動かしていて、推論エンジンを上げたら、GPUに置けるexpertが約24%増えました。 (Strata v0.2.15)
🚀 Strata v0.2.16 is OUT — a major update for local AI! ... Strata’s own inference engine — another major milestone! (sin llama.cpp kernels)
I tried Strata few weeks ago and was a bit disappointed: it was like twice faster than llama.cpp in tok/s generation but actual tasks took ~the same wall time to finish.

The graph demonstrates decode and pre-fill at different depths. Over my old llama.cpp build, it is a massive jump in performance. ... The last time I tried Strata, it did not beat my llama.cpp build.

New update of Strata is out! Newly trained DFlash2 drafter for Strix Halo and Mac.
These changes were made for actual stability, long-horizon tasks that are complex. The number of releases has become lower due to the fact I want to keep Strata stable.
Strata 0.2.11 is now out! Supports new Unsloth Qwen3.8-Flash-Next quants.
Unsloths support for Deepseek is here! Improvements on Strix.

A BIG update is here! Qwen3.8 Flash Next now runs on a 8GB graphics card at 20+ tokens/second.
In the not so distant future, you will just need SSD + small gpu.

Easy on that update, it is a part of much larger one.

use STRATA to run QWEN 3.8 FLASH.

“4× faster” needs a configuration next to it; the reported values aren't evidence that every machine will be four times faster.
Strata en 2x 3090: +10-12% prefill tras 1.9x en BF16 tensor math.
Strix Halo + Strata 0.2.15: 896-1181 tok/s en 4K-32K prompt tras tuning.

Strata en 4x RX 7900 XTX (RDNA3/ROCm): decode 81.3 tok/s (pico 126.9), prefill 1456 tok/s vs llama.cpp.
"Strata is 1.8x slower on DeepSeek" - I measured it, and I was right (until one flag fixed it).
One 3090 just beat Strata on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (llamAmpere 12% faster than Strata).
It's possible this PR could solve the problems with AMD reported in the release notes.
Curious to hear how this works on xestrata.

How do you make speculative decoding fast at any batch size? ... on AMD Instinct MI355X ... ~300 tok/s ... 1.6× faster than built-in MTP ... performance holds from 1-32 concurrent conversations.
No direct head-to-head exists yet. NVIDIA’s 4B AR draft hits ~5.5 accepted tokens ... DFlash2 uses a lighter ~1.9B ... posts 4–5.5 acceptance on block-8 with 2.7–3.4× end-to-end speedups on H200.
SpecSearch (UIUC) ... Qwen3-4B with a DFlash drafter in vLLM on an RTX 5090 ran 3.50-fold faster ... averaged 2.01-fold over plain decoding ... on H100, L40 and MI300X.

when speculative decoding checks drafts ... on Qwen3.8-27B in vLLM, checking 2 tokens per pass ... going from 4 tokens to 8 with DFlash2 added only 4.7 ms more ... the 2-token pass comes from MTP and the 4 and 8 token passes from DFlash2.
Qwen3.8-27B ... Baseline: 82 tokens/sec, Optimized MTP: 114, DFlash2 + context lookup: 138, Optimized lookup verification: 381 ... speculative decoding ... MTP and DFlash2 use different approaches.
Qwen3.8-27B ... Baseline 82 → Optimized MTP 114 → DFlash2 + context lookup 138 → 381 tokens/sec ... speculative decoding reduces sequential generation work.
Qwen3.8-27B ... speculative decoding ... optimized MTP ... DFlash2 and context lookup ... blocks of up to 16 tokens, accepting roughly 15 per block.
Qwen3.8-27B ... speculative decoding ... DFlash2 ... blocks of up to 16 tokens and accepting roughly 15 per block ... 381 tokens/sec.

Speculative decoding ... MTP is a multi-token head ... DFlash2 is a separate lightweight non-autoregressive block drafter that proposes ~7 tokens in parallel ... acceptance is near-perfect (often 15 of 16).
A 2026 NeurIPS workshop paper tested speculative decoding on Macs with Qwen3-4B 4-bit ... every method got slower. DFlash: −32.5% on an M2 Pro chip.
Using Qwen3.8-27B as an agent ... retains its MTP head for speculative decoding.
A 27B model on one 24 GB graphics card generated 30 tokens a second. With speculative decoding drafting up to 3 tokens ahead, the same card did 60.
Strata 0.1.59 ... MTP window 4 at confidence 0.5 ... Strata accepted 511–556 of the 907–975 drafts it offered.
NVIDIA’s Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B ... bundled DFlash for speculative decoding speedups.
Speculative decoding isn't always faster. Under heavy concurrency, it can actually hurt throughput.
NVIDIA Releases a 4B Draft Model ... 46% higher token acceptance than Qwen3.8-27B’s built-in speculative decoding head.
NVIDIA’s 4B draft model achieves 46% higher token acceptance ... speculative decoding.
(links to article on local inference comparisons including speculative decoding configs).
STRATA ... MTP speculative decoding: max 4, Lookup speculation: 3 ... BASALT ... Speculative decoding: 8.
STRATA vs BASALT ... client-side estimates were significantly inflated by differences in ... speculative-decoding accounting.
